component.name: Remora
component.summary: Build, deploy and mirror Android running in Docker

description.p: Remora is a desktop control plane for Android in Docker: compose an Android image feature by feature and build it from source, deploy it to this machine or to any docker host over ssh, and connect with Remora's own hardware-accelerated mirror — a Qt client talking to an agent baked into the image. A headless CLI and a QtWidgets workspace share one unit-tested core.

screenshot.caption: The workspace: each profile's image, docker host, status and actions

description.p: Remora's own mirror protocol, Android 17 without the ashmem module, and release packages:

ul.li: The mirror speaks protocol v3, Remora's own wire format. Images built before this release need a rebuild for the new agent
Android 17 images no longer need the host ashmem kernel module; only Android 16 images do
The device agent survives a mirror session stopped mid-frame, and a video encoder that produces nothing gets one fallback and then a stated error
Profiles rendering on the guest GPU stream H.264, since there is no hardware HEVC encoder there
--help after any command prints the usage instead of running the command
Releases ship a source tarball, a .deb and an Arch PKGBUILD, and the native helpers are built along with Remora

description.p: First public release: compose an Android 16 or 17 image feature by feature and build it from source, deploy it to this machine or to a docker host over ssh, and mirror it with Remora's own client and in-image agent.
